area: Sidebar - Work Order List and Search
title: 'Search work orders' matches customer name, unit number, and technician name
preconditions: 1. You are signed in on a desktop browser.
2. Work orders exist with distinct customer names, unit numbers, and lead technicians.
3. You are on the Schedule page with the work order list visible.
steps: 1. In 'Search work orders', type part of a customer name; note the results, then clear.
2. Type a unit number; note the results, then clear.
3. Type a technician's name; note the results.
expected: 1. Customer-name search shows only cards for that customer.
2. Unit-number search shows only cards with that unit.
3. Technician-name search shows only cards where that technician appears on the card.
4. All four searchable fields (WO number, customer, unit, technician) are fields visible on the card itself.
